name: The Travails
description: The Travails is the catastrophe that broke Innistrad, when Avacyn fell and the plane's holy places were warped and the undead swelled in number.

summary.text: The Travails is the catastrophe that broke Innistrad, when Avacyn fell and the plane's holy places were warped and the undead swelled in number.

bio.text: Pages from 2021 describe it as a catastrophe when Avacyn fell and wolfir overran the woods, after which the nights grew longer and the days too short.
It ruined Innistrad, felling Gavony and the angels, and magic became harder as the plane fell apart.
Arlinn is reminded of it by the aftermath of the massacre, and it was an earlier catastrophe in which friend and foe were hard to tell apart.
Torens served as a Mausoleum Guard before it.
In 2026, Tam reaches an inn and learns from Moiren about the Travails and how cathars killed the Town, and the event is called the near-apocalypse when a monster in the moon nearly ended the plane.

status.text: As of September 2026 it is described as a past near-apocalypse in which a monster in the moon nearly ended the plane.

timeline.summary: Tam reaches an inn and learns from Moiren about the Travails and how cathars killed the Town.
